svg.aria-label: The same window of 4 for 16 positions, built two ways. As a mask the machine works out all 256 squares of the 16 by 16 grid and throws most away. In chunks of 4 it only builds each chunk against its own 4 positions and the 4 before: 112 squares. The 58 squares the window keeps are the same either way. Doubling the row makes the mask grid four times bigger and the chunks only twice; at 4,096 positions that is 35.5 GB against 15.1 GB.
svg.text: The window as a mask, and in chunks
16 positions, each looking back at most 4. Every square is one match worked out and held in memory.

g.text: Double the row and the mask's grid grows four times; the chunks only grow twice.
